activity_summary: At night, still flat, you named the snap as a lute-string. You had lifted from the back. You had not fallen. You kept both of Anne's sentences, the unkind and the kind, and you did not call the back mended.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke it to the dark over the hall, and ended.

facets.activity: Named the snap as a lute-string

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not fall. That is the whole boast, and it is a small one.
